+"""Visual, state-feedback controller for the single GR1 tabletop episode.
+
+Each invocation obtains a fresh camera/proprio observation, makes one gradual
+motion, and records the resulting observation.  Positions supplied on the
+command line are world-frame metres, estimated from RGB-D camera geometry.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+BASE_T = np.array([2.67072, -2.12925, 0.89836])
+BASE_R = np.array([[0., -1., 0.], [1., 0., 0.], [0., 0., 1.]])
+CAMS = ["egoview", "robot0_eye_in_right_hand", "robot0_eye_in_left_hand"]
+
+
+def world_to_base(p):
+    return BASE_R.T @ (np.asarray(p, dtype=float) - BASE_T)
+
+
+def command_from_meta(meta):
+    p = meta["proprio"]
+    d = dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))
+    names = Robot().spec()["action_types"]["ee_pose"]["layout"]
+    return np.array([d["cmd_" + n] for n in names], dtype=float)
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("stage")
+    ap.add_argument("--right-world", type=float, nargs=3)
+    ap.add_argument("--left-world", type=float, nargs=3)
+    ap.add_argument("--right-hand", type=float, nargs=6)
+    ap.add_argument("--left-hand", type=float, nargs=6)
+    ap.add_argument("--right-rotation", type=float, nargs=3)
+    ap.add_argument("--left-rotation", type=float, nargs=3)
+    ap.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=30)
+    ap.add_argument("--watch", type=float, default=0)
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+
+    r = Robot()
+    before = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMS, video="none")
+    d = dict(zip(before.meta["proprio"]["layout"], before.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
+    names = r.spec()["action_types"]["ee_pose"]["layout"]
+    start = np.array([d["cmd_" + n] for n in names], dtype=float)
+    target = start.copy()
+    if args.right_world:
+        target[0:3] = world_to_base(args.right_world)
+    if args.left_world:
+        target[6:9] = world_to_base(args.left_world)
+    if args.right_rotation:
+        target[3:6] = args.right_rotation
+    if args.left_rotation:
+        target[9:12] = args.left_rotation
+    if args.right_hand:
+        target[12:18] = args.right_hand
+    if args.left_hand:
+        target[18:24] = args.left_hand
+
+    if args.watch:
+        result = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMS, seconds=args.watch,
+                           include_depth=True, video="none")
+    else:
+        rows = np.linspace(start, target, args.steps + 1)[1:]
+        result = r.submit("ee_pose", rows, cameras=CAMS, include_depth=True,
+                          video="none", note=args.stage)
+    out = "/app/runs/" + args.stage
+    result.save(out)
+    fields = {k: result.meta.get(k) for k in
+              ("time_left_s", "control_steps", "done", "reason", "executed_rows")}
+    pp = dict(zip(result.meta["proprio"]["layout"], result.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
+    fields["eef_world"] = {side: [pp["eef_" + side + "_" + c]
+                                  for c in "xyz"] for side in ("right", "left")}
+    fields["cmd"] = [pp["cmd_" + n] for n in names]
+    print(json.dumps(fields, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch"));
